title: my scorpio date has a very strange relationship with my phone
caption: date three. she still hasn't given it back

beats.speaker: him
beats.text: my scorpio date has a very strange relationship with my phone

beats.speaker: him
beats.text: i put it face down at dinner

beats.speaker: him
beats.text: she turned it face up without saying a word.

beats.speaker: him
beats.text: apparently, scorpios don't trust a face-down phone.

beats.speaker: him
beats.text: i'm a gemini. i have nothing to hide.

beats.speaker: him
beats.text: i just have four group chats and i reply to none of them.
